criteria.description: 提交输入、日志、轨迹和派生统计，保持可追溯关系。
依据研究者选定并论证的方案，审核原生模拟有效性、采样充分性及不确定性；不预先指定步长、时长、种子或重复数。
审核结构与区段关联结论的可复核性、方法适配性、不确定性和限定范围；参考作者结果用于评测上下文，不强制新结果支持其响应方向。

verification_basis.rationale: 已取得官方 MD5 验证的原版 WT/中和输入和轨迹；5 个 WT 独立种子、结构/配位、A2 电荷身份及声明选择下的响应经独立重算。作者突变轨迹只有一条，不把它冒充五次重复；发布的均值与 error 列是另一参考，误差语义与方法差异需说明。判据审核新执行结果及其不确定度，不强制逐位等于发表值。

criteria.review: Verify force-field/model identity and the full declared A2 intervention in generated inputs. The intervention includes both the specified charge neutralization and self-LJ changes; do not accept a charge-only causal claim.

Verify the study establishes a condensate rather than treating the 466-bead construction unit as a condensate; assess WT/A2 comparability of preparation, density or volume, observables, and analysis windows.

Verify lineage from generated inputs through logs and trajectories, numerical validity, equilibration, production sampling, and independence claims. Choices are justified by the submitted protocol; no fixed timestep, duration, or replicate count is prescribed.
Independently assess/recompute the declared PD spatial-structure result from new trajectories, including selections, periodic boundaries, normalization, units, time window, and uncertainty.
Independently assess/recompute the declared A2-rpL5 association result from new trajectories, including selections, periodic boundaries, normalization, units, time window, and uncertainty.

Verify the uncertainty semantics and decision rule, answer/data consistency, and limitations. Support, refute, and evidence-based inconclusive conclusions are all acceptable; absence of new evidence is not a scientific inconclusive result.

qualification.blocker: Local self-scoring verifier: deterministic integrity checks, local analysis replay, and deterministic scientific criteria award reward without an evaluator receipt.
